subject.title: Bug:  ignores  config and returns success on media failure

question: Should Feishu CLI media sends accept a Feishu-specific `channels.feishu.mediaLocalRoots` key now, wait for the broader filesystem/media roots contract, or keep managed roots only and fix the misleading success behavior first?
rationale: The remaining work spans local file-read security and delivery-status semantics, so automation should not choose a new config surface or fail-closed behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Fix success reporting first
options.body: Make Feishu media upload failure explicit to the caller while keeping the current managed-root policy until the broader roots direction is settled.

options.title: Add Feishu media roots
options.body: Accept and document `channels.feishu.mediaLocalRoots` with schema, docs, tests, and security review for the new host path allowance.

options.title: Tie to broader roots work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Feishu-specific status/fallback case while resolving the local-root policy through the broader filesystem roots direction.

recommendation.title: Fix success reporting first
recommendation.body: Make Feishu media upload failure explicit to the caller while keeping the current managed-root policy until the broader roots direction is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to the current shared media access plumbing and current Feishu fallback/config lines, making them the best available routing owner for this policy choice.
